lead_raw_text:
The structure of Mn6Ag2Sn2Se16 (Mn3AgSnSe8) is monoclinic, space group C2/c (No. 15), with 26 atoms per unit cell across five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived coordination analysis shows Ag and Sn each coordinated by four Se neighbors, while Mn centers have six Se neighbors. The Se environment includes both 4- and 7-neighbor sites. Validated polyhedral contacts reveal corner-sharing between Mn 6-vertex and Sn 4-vertex polyhedra, and edge-sharing between Mn polyhedra; the periodic neighbor graph forms a single 3-dimensional component.
